usage: corvint-test-runner <command> [flags] (experimental runner companion)

  runners    list runner profile IDs as JSON (no executable pin)

cases.name: runners-help
cases.stdout:
usage: corvint-test-runner runners

Lists the runner profile IDs as JSON. No executable pin is needed.

cases.name: plan-help
cases.stdout:
usage: corvint-test-runner plan [flags]

flags:
  -approve string
    	exact canonical plan SHA256
  -executable string
    	independently trusted absolute executable
  -executable-sha256 string
    	independently pinned executable SHA256
  -experimental
    	admit experimental execution
  -out string
    	NEW output JSON file; default stdout
  -plan string
    	previously reviewed plan JSON
  -request string
    	bounded request JSON
  -tools string
    	independently trusted auxiliary Tool map JSON
  -trusted-local
    	admit execution of trusted local tests
